# Warlock AI Bedrock

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-bedrock`

> AWS Bedrock adapter for @warlock.js/ai

## Skills

- [ai-bedrock](@warlock.js/ai-bedrock/skills/SKILL.md): Amazon Bedrock adapter for Warlock AI: `BedrockSDK`, `BedrockCallOptions`, `bedrockPricingFor` and regional pricing registries. Use for "run Claude on AWS", "configure Bedrock credentials", Converse streaming, tools, caching or Titan embeddings through `model()` and `embedder()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai-anthropic for direct Anthropic access; @warlock.js/ai for orchestration.
